sql_evidence.sql_literal: SELECT current_user AS role, current_setting('transaction_read_only') AS read_only, current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role',true) AS jwt_role

SELECT id,created_at,payload->'source_pack_version' AS source_pack_version,payload->'fetch_spec_version' AS fetch_spec_version,payload->'sql_caller_count' AS declared_sql,payload->'trigger_binding_count' AS declared_triggers,payload->'test_case_count' AS declared_tests,payload->'usage_stats' AS usage_stats,payload->'historical_provenance_only' AS historical_provenance FROM public.lf_eventos WHERE id=20161

usage_stats.interpretation: track_functions none means zero stat rows cannot prove no usage; static governed graph supplies inventory currentness

historical_provenance.router_note: Router binding snapshot observes readiness revision 5.12 while governed current readiness snapshot is 5.13; retained as provenance/currentness drift only.
historical_provenance.contract_note: Older input contract rows remain recorded; caller usage is not inferred from their existence.

sql_evidence.sql_literal: SELECT count(*) AS n,count(DISTINCT x->>'dedupe_key') AS unique_callers,count(*) FILTER(WHERE x->>'operational_class'='ACTIVE') AS active,count(*) FILTER(WHERE x->>'definition_md5' ~ '^[a-f0-9]{32}$') AS md5_syntax_valid,count(*) FILTER(WHERE x->>'caller_oid' ~ '^[0-9]+$') AS oids_present,count(*) FILTER(WHERE x->>'currentness_source'='LIVE_PG_PROC') AS historically_marked_live FROM public.lf_eventos e CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(e.payload->'sql_callers') x WHERE e.id=20161

SELECT count(*) total_edges,count(DISTINCT concat(x->>'caller','->',callee.name)) distinct_edges,count(DISTINCT callee.name) distinct_callees,count(*) FILTER(WHERE callee.name LIKE '%cached%') cached_name_edges,count(DISTINCT callee.name) FILTER(WHERE callee.name LIKE '%cached%') cached_name_targets FROM public.lf_eventos e CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(e.payload->'sql_callers') x CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(x->'callees') callee(name) WHERE e.id=20161

SELECT jsonb_array_length(payload->'edge_current') AS edge_entries,jsonb_array_length(payload->'external_inventory') AS external_entries,jsonb_array_length(payload->'trigger_bindings') AS triggers,jsonb_array_length(payload->'consumer_relation_snapshot_json_rows') AS consumer_snapshots,payload->'pg_depend_direct_rows' AS pg_depend_direct_rows,payload->'unexplained_material_callers' AS unexplained_material_callers FROM public.lf_eventos WHERE id=20161

SELECT x->>'operational_class' AS operational_class,x->>'governance_lifecycle' AS governance_lifecycle,count(*) AS n FROM public.lf_eventos e CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(e.payload->'external_inventory') x WHERE e.id=20161 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT id,created_at,receipt_kind,subject_ref,verification_ref,receipt_sha256,payload->'pass' AS historical_pass,payload->'verification_status' AS status,payload->'screens_total' AS screens,payload->'families_total' AS families,payload->'screens_below_2' AS insufficient_screens,payload->'families_below_2' AS insufficient_families,payload->'known_false_pass_signals' AS false_pass,payload->'unresolved_d4' AS d4 FROM programacion.provenance_receipts WHERE id=38

SELECT codigo,primera_vez,causa_raiz,prevencion,validacion FROM transversal.error_knowledge WHERE codigo IN ('IG-M107-SOAK-CRITERION-DRIFT-001','IG-M107-CP2-READ-ROLE-CURRENTNESS-001') AND primera_vez < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-15 00:00:00+00' ORDER BY codigo

rows.prevencion: Leer EKB y action_spec. No elevar EXECUTE ni crear motor. Reusar recibo verificado SOAK_OBSERVATION_HISTORY_V2 y revisar la cohorte mediante tablas con SELECT autorizado. Considerar recuentos brutos como evidencia complementaria, nunca sustituto de as-of. Rectificar únicamente queries CP2.
rows.validacion: 2026-10-14: Q1 receipt 38 PASS, Q2 cohort PASS_OBSERVED 13/13 screens, 47 families, 199 completed runs. SQL 42501 reproducido. Migración revierte primer ensayo y lee CP2 DONE, otros tres pendientes sin autorizar producción.

rows.causa_raiz: Desalineación de proyección textual del contrato M10.7 frente a la autoridad SOAK_OBSERVATION_HISTORY_V2 de M9.11.
rows.prevencion: Antes de CP1 leer M9.11 DONE y el recibo VERIFIED; heredar >=2 as-of, 0 falsos PASS y 0 D4. Reusar historia. No convertir 13/47 en obligación de nuevas corridas ni confundir latest CURRENT con validez histórica. Confirmar los checkpoints posteriores por su naturaleza.
rows.validacion: Read-only 2026-10-14: receipt 38 13/13 screens,47/47 families, zero below-2, false_pass=0,D4=0; tres negativos sintéticos rechazados. Migración prueba rollback y comprueba CP1 DONE/CP2 PENDING, sin activar producción.

findings.impact: Evita transferir currentness de otra fecha o contrato
